PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

WHERE
  { ?uri  <http://dbpedia.org/property/screenplay>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Daniel_Waters_(screenwriter)> ;

  }

question: Give me all commanders which had an important role in both, the Battle of Fort Stephenson and Battle of the Thames?
sparql:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?uri
WHERE
  {   { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Battle_of_Fort_Stephenson>
                  <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/commander>  ?uri
      }
    UNION
      { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Siege_of_Fort_Meigs>
                  <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/commander>  ?uri .
        <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Battle_of_Fort_Stephenson>
                  <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/commander>  ?uri
      }
    UNION
      { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Battle_of_the_Thames>
                  <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/commander>  ?uri
      }
  }

WHERE
  {   { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Cascade_Airways>
                  <http://dbpedia.org/property/hubs>  ?hub
      }
    UNION
      { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Cascade_Airways>

        FILTER EXISTS { ?silverAirways
                                  <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/hubAirport>  ?airport
                      }
        BIND(?airport AS ?hub)
      }
  }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?uri
WHERE
  {   { PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
        PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
        PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
        PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
        PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
        
        SELECT DISTINCT  ?uri
        WHERE
          { ?x  <http://dbpedia.org/property/operatingSystem>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Unix-like> ;
                <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/developer>  ?uri
          }
      }
    UNION
      { PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
        PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

        PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
        PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
        
        SELECT DISTINCT  ?uri

          { ?x  <http://dbpedia.org/property/operatingSystem>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Cross-platform> ;
                <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/developer>  ?uri ;
                rdf:type              <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/Software>
          }
      }
    UNION
      { PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
        PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
        PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
        PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
        PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
        
        SELECT DISTINCT  ?uri
        WHERE
          { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Macintosh_Quadra_660AV>
                      <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/operatingSystem>  ?x .
            ?x        <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/developer>  ?uri ;
                      rdf:type              <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/Software>
          }
      }
  }

PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?artist
WHERE
  {   { ?artist  <http://dbpedia.org/property/associatedActs>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Kris_Kristofferson> ;
                 rdf:type              <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/Artist>

      { ?artist  <http://dbpedia.org/property/associatedActs>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Johnny_Cash> ;
                 <http://dbpedia.org/property/associatedActs>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Kris_Kristofferson>
      }
    UNION
      { <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Oh!_Darling>
                  <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/musicalArtist>  <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Robin_Gibb>
        BIND(<http://dbpedia.org/resource/Robin_Gibb> AS ?artist)
      }
  }
ORDER BY ?artist
